anxiety.action: Inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 2, exhale for 6 seconds. Repeat 5 times.

anger.body_state: jaw tension, hot face, clenched hands
anger.action: Stomp your feet slowly 10 times. Then take 3 long slow exhales.

sadness.body_state: heavy chest, low energy, slow body
sadness.action: Place one hand on your chest. Breathe slowly and feel the warmth for 1 minute.

freeze.body_state: numbness, inability to move, disconnected feeling
freeze.action: Stand up and shake your body gently for 20 seconds. Then exhale slowly 5 times.

neutral.action: Take 3 slow breaths. You are grounded right now.

critical.action: You are not alone. Please consider reaching out to a trusted person or a local helpline immediately.
